commits.message:
fix(themes): every bundled theme draws named colours in its own ANSI table (rich-docs-examples-xuu.8tt)

defineTheme gave every TerminalTheme STANDARD_TABLE, so `[blue]` exported
under ATOM_ONE_DARK was VGA #000080 on #282c34. Each theme data file now
carries a required `ansi` table, taken from the published terminal scheme
whose background matches the theme (iTerm2-Color-Schemes), from Rich for
`default` and `svg-export`, and from Textual's own MONOKAI/ALABASTER
fallback for the Textual-native themes and cyberpunk, which have none.

Atom One uses "One Half Dark/Light": the "Atom One Light" port draws cyan
as the same #3F953A as green.

docs: the renderable pages show their examples' real output (rich-docs-examples-xuu.0o4) (#178)

* docs: the renderable pages show their examples' real output (rich-docs-examples-xuu.0o4)

tables, tree, columns, padding, group, layout, syntax, markdown, pretty, strip
and viewport come off NOT_YET_MIGRATED: every drawn output block is gone, every
example runs and prints in colour, and prose that described output the code does
not produce now describes what it does. panel.md's examples gain colour too.
Library bugs the real output exposed are filed, not fixed: rich-tree-sgk,
rich-tree-736, rich-panel-ech, rich-padding-wee, rich-padding-wv28,
rich-table-ca0, rich-table-3u2, rich-markdown-thj, rich-markdown-ft8,
rich-syntax-fh2, rich-pretty-v7b.

* docs(tables): the box-style row wraps at 75 columns, and the prose says so (rich-docs-examples-xuu.0o4)
